BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 28 tests pass and describes a reasonable technical approach (integer cent computation with residual allocation), there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The absence of verifiable artifacts—particularly test results and the actual code changes—means the acceptance criteria cannot be independently confirmed.
